mainText: This is the Gaza Dispatch audio briefing for June 2, 2026. Here are the key source-backed developments from today's edition. 1. 3 Gazans killed by Israeli fire in latest ceasefire violations. ⁠Israeli army continues its daily violations of ceasefire in Palestinian enclave. This was reported by Anadolu Agency. 2. The Zionist false narratives are beginning to unravel. Former Dutch ambassador Nikolaos van Dam recounts how political pressure and bias shaped Western policy on. Israel's occupation of Palestine. This was reported by The New Arab. 3. How Francois Burgat became a target of France's Gaza crackdown. Iran halts talks with U.S. over Israeli actions in Lebanon, Gaza. Trumps says.
